title: Deny the Pass One Pass Away
description: A defender practises denying the easy pass to a player one pass away, staying in the passing lane with a hand ready to deflect.

content.objective: Stay in the passing lane to deny the ball while still seeing both the ball and the offensive player.
content.setup: A ball handler at the top looks to pass to a teammate one pass away on the wing.
instructions: The defender positions with a hand and foot in the passing lane, body angled to see both ball and player.
The ball handler looks to find a passing window at different angles.
The defender adjusts position with every ball movement, staying in the lane.
Rotate: a completed pass means the denial defender switches roles.
coachingPoints: Keep a hand in the passing lane at all times, not down at the side.
See the ball and the player at the same time — never fully turn the back on either.
Move on the pass, not after it.
commonMistakes: Turning the back on the ball to watch only the offensive player.
Standing flat-footed instead of adjusting with ball movement.
Reaching with the hands instead of moving the feet.
content.safety: Hands stay in the passing lane only, no grabbing the offensive player.
